 227: class ReservationService:
 228:     """Ports belong to trusted generated bootstrap, never serialized profiles.
 229: 
 230:     open_journal(physical) returns an already-retained journal port.
 231:     observe_worker(worker) validates a live retained owner and returns PID/time.
 232:     confirm_teardown(worker, evidence) must independently validate exact live
 233:     ownership, zero pending work and completed guard retirement. No disk value
 234:     is passed as evidence. Real versions of these ports are not implemented.
 235: 
 236:     confirm_live_reconciliation(worker, physical, generation, head, attempt) is
 237:     a separate trusted observer fixed at construction. It must freshly confirm
 238:     the exact retained owner is stopped, no work/I/O remains, and guards have
 239:     retired. It binds these observations to this unique attempt and current
 240:     physical/generation/head. Recorded identities and earlier receipts cannot
 241:     satisfy it. This callback does not acquire ownership from a recorded PID.
 242:     """
 243:     def __init__(self, gates, open_journal, observe_worker, confirm_teardown,
 244:                  confirm_live_reconciliation=None):
 245:         self.gates, self._open, self._observe, self._finish = gates, open_journal, observe_worker, confirm_teardown
 246:         self._reconcile_live = confirm_live_reconciliation
 247:         self._live = {}
 248: 
 249:     def begin(self, physical, semantic, generation, new_snapshot_evidence=None):
 250:         gate = self.gates.acquire(physical)
 251:         token = Reservation(self, physical, semantic, generation, gate, None, b"")
 252:         self._live[gate] = token
 253:         try:
 254:             token.journal = self._open(physical)
 255:             token.raw = token.journal.read_all()
 256:             # Empty state requires a private bootstrap registry entry; no
 257:             # caller-provided dataclass/profile can register a new snapshot.
 258:             if token.raw == b"":
 259:                 self.gates.consume_creation(physical, gate, new_snapshot_evidence)
 260:                 token.raw = token.journal.append_confirmed(b"", encode_next(b"", physical, semantic, None, "INITIALIZED"))
 261:             else:
 262:                 rows, head = decode_journal(token.raw)
 263:                 _require(rows[-1]["physical"] == physical.wire(), "physical_record_mismatch")
 264:                 _require(rows[-1]["phase"] in ("INITIALIZED", "CLEARED") and self.gates.known_clean(physical, gate, head),
 265:                          "restart_reconciliation_required")
 266:             token.raw = token.journal.append_confirmed(token.raw, encode_next(token.raw, physical, semantic, generation, "RESERVED"))
 267:             with token._lock:
 268:                 self._owned(token)
 269:                 _require(not token.revoked and token.phase == "RESERVED", "reservation_revoked_before_publication")
 270:                 return token
 271:         except BaseException as exc:
 272:             token.phase, token.persistence_failure = "QUARANTINED", type(exc).__name__
 273:             token.revoked = True
 274:             # Keep both gate and any partial journal ownership. No fake unlock.
 275:             raise
